title: Base class for warnings generated by user code.
summary: A subclass of Warning, Exception, BaseException.

title: Check that a variable is not used before it's defined.
summary: Mypy will generate an error if a name is used before it's defined. While the name-defined check will catch issues with names that are undefined, it will not flag if a variable is used and then defined later in the scope. used-before-def check will catch such cases. mypy enables this error code by default.
